label: Def:2.1
title: Definition
body_md:
\label{Def:2.1}
A family $S=\{S(t,\tau): t\in\mathbb{R}^{+}, \tau\in\mathbb{R}\}$ of mappings from $(\mathcal{P}_p(X), d_{\mathcal{P}(X)})$ to $(\mathcal{P}_p(X), d_{\mathcal{P}(X)})$ is called a continuous non-autonomous dynamical system on $(\mathcal{P}_p(X), d_{\mathcal{P}(X)})$, if for all $\tau\in\mathbb{R}$ and $t,s\in\mathbb{R}^{+}$, the following conditions are satisfied:\par
$(\mathbf{i})\ S(0,\tau)=I_{\mathcal{P}_{p}(X)}$, where $I_{\mathcal{P}_{p}(X)}$ is the identity operator on $(\mathcal{P}_p(X), d_{\mathcal{P}(X)})$;\par
$(\mathbf{ii})\ S(t+s,\tau)=S(t,s+\tau)\circ S(s,\tau)$.\par
\par

label: Def:2.3
title: Definition
body_md:
\label{Def:2.3}
The non-autonomous dynamical system $S$ is said to be $\mathcal{D}$-pullback asymptotically compact in $\mathcal{P}_{p}(X)$ if for each $\tau\in\mathbb{R},\{S(t_{n},\tau-t_{n})\mu_{n}\}^{\infty}_{n=1}$ has a convergent subsequence in $\mathcal{P}_{p}(X)$ wherever $t_{n}\rightarrow +\infty$ and $\mu_{n}\in D(\tau-t_{n})$ with $D\in\mathcal{D}$.

label: pro:2.1
title: Proposition
body_md:
\label{pro:2.1}
Let $\mathcal{D}$ be an inclusion-closed collection of families of nonempty bounded subsets of $\mathcal{P}_{p}(X)$, and $S$ be a continuous non-autonomous dynamical system on $(\mathcal{P}_p(X), d_{\mathcal{P}(X)})$. Then $S$ has a unique $\mathcal{D}$-pullback measure attractor $\mathcal{A}\in\mathcal{D}$ in $(\mathcal{P}_p(X), d_{\mathcal{P}(X)})$ if and only if $S$ has a closed $\mathcal{D}$-pullback absorbing set $K\in\mathcal{D}$ and $S$ is $\mathcal{D}$-pullback asymptotically compact in $(\mathcal{P}_p(X), d_{\mathcal{P}(X)})$.
